page.overview:
Who is Brownbeard?

Chadros Higelyges, better known as Brownbeard, is a former New World pirate. As captain of the Brownbeard Pirates, he was one of many opportunists to attack the Whitebeard Pirates' protected territories in wake of Whitebeard's death, conquering Foodvalten in particular.

After being decimated by Basil Hawkins, he and his crew fled to Punk Hazard, where Caesar Clown restored them. Under further augmentations from Trafalgar Law, he became head of Punk Hazard's Centaur Patrol Unit, loyally guarding his new "Master's" laboratories until he was betrayed and left for dead.

He is a minor antagonist-turned-ally of the Straw Hats during the Punk Hazard Arc.

Brownbeard is a very large, overweight man who appears to be roughly three times the height and four times the width of a normal human. He possesses a long brown beard, with three distinctly kept braids, as well as a mustache. He wears a large coat, over an open shirt, that seems to only reach to his shoulders. He leaves his chest bare, with something that appears to be a large wrestling belt with his jolly roger on it. His hair appears to come out of the top of his tricorne and is braided back.
